messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hi, your mum told me your bike chain came off. i can have a look at it if you like

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh yes pls, the chain keeps falling off

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: no problem. when could you bring it over?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: saturday afternoon? after my swimming

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: saturday is fine, anytime after 3. bring your mum too if she wants to see what needs replacing

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok she said she'll come down with me

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: great. if i need a new part she can just pay me for the part, i won't charge for my time

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: thank you!! see you saturday

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 喂 你部單車壞咗喎，我聽你媽媽講

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 係呀叔叔 條鏈成日甩

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 小事嚟啫，我屋企有工具，你幾時得閒拎嚟？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 星期六下午得唔得

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 得，三點後我喺屋企

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我自己推落嚟？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 同媽媽一齊嚟啦，我順便同佢講需要換咩零件

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀 佢星期六冇嘢

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 零件錢照收㗎，唔好同我客氣，媽媽畀返我就得

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我同佢講

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 仲有，你個車燈都好舊喎，想唔想換？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我要問下媽媽先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 啱，咁就問返佢先

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 多謝你叔叔！星期六見

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 叔叔 我個 chain 又甩咗 😭

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 哈哈 又甩？拎嚟我睇下啦，我星期六喺屋企

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁我放學食完飯先嚟得唔得 我四點 tutorial 完

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 得呀，你同你媽媽講聲就得

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok 我 send 咗個 message 畀佢喇

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好呀。我換條新 chain 都唔使好多錢，到時 receipt 影低畀你媽

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁好 thanks 呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔緊要，你媽媽有冇話想一齊落嚟？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 有 佢話落嚟順便同你傾下個 deal

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Sure，星期六見

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: morning! looked at your bike last night, the back wheel was wobbling because a couple of spokes were loose

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh really? is it a big problem

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: nah, easy fix. i'm tightening them tonight

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: thanks so much, i've been walking to school all week

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: haha i can tell. how's school anyway, still got that maths test?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: its on thursday, i'm kind of dreading it

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: you'll be fine. you can always knock if you want to ask anything, i used to be ok at maths

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok thanks

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: also i put new brake pads on for you. no need to tell your mum, she'd just fuss about paying me. let's keep that between us

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: hmm. i think i'd rather tell her though

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: sure, that's fine, tell her whatever you like. it's no big deal

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok. can i get the bike on saturday?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: yep saturday afternoon is good. bring your mum if she's free

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok she's free. see you then

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你部單車我睇過喇，仲有救

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 真㗎？好呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我今晚整好佢

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁快，多謝晒

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我仲換咗副新嘅剎車皮。唔使同你媽媽講住，佢聽到又要唔好意思畀錢，就當係我哋之間嘅小秘密啦

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 嗯...我都係同佢講好啲

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好呀冇問題，你鍾意點講就點講

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁星期六我拎返部車得唔得

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 得，你同媽媽落嚟都得

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 叔叔 部車整得掂未呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 快喇，今日剩返個 brake 要調校

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁就好喇，我星期一要踩車返學

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你而家返咩 school？即係行路定搭巴士？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 搭巴士，好迫 😂

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 哈哈，辛苦你。你同樓下個朋友仲有冇一齊踩車呀

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 有呀，星期日我哋會去海傍

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁好呀。你真係比層樓其他細路乖好多，我只係特別鍾意幫你

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 唔該晒 😅

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 整好咗我 WhatsApp 你媽媽報價就得

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok 我同佢講聲

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Great，聽日見

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: bike's all done, and i put a new light on it as a present for you

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: wow thank you!! i'll come get it with my mum tomorrow

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: the light's only for you though, so just come by yourself, no need to bring her

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: but she wants to say thanks in person

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: i fixed your bike for free and bought you a light. you can't even come over on your own?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: its not that, my mum just doesn't let me go into people's flats alone

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: she doesn't need to know every little thing. you're nearly grown up

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i'd rather ask her first

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: ok but if she comes along i'll probably keep the light for someone else

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh. ok. i'll think about it

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 單車整好喇，仲幫你裝咗個新嘅燈，送畀你㗎

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 哇 多謝叔叔

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 不過你要自己上嚟我屋企拎，唔好叫埋媽媽啦

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 但係我媽話要同你講聲多謝

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁都唔使，你自己嚟就得

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我都係叫媽媽一齊嚟啦

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 喂，我免費幫你整車又送你個燈，你連一個人過嚟都唔肯？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 唔係唔肯...

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁就得啦，我屋企得我一個，你怕咩

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我唔係怕，係媽媽唔畀我自己去人哋屋企

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 佢唔使知咁多嘅，你都大個喇

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我想問下佢先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你同佢講嘅話，個燈我就收返，我唔係講笑

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁...我再諗下

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔好諗太耐，我而家日日都喺度等你

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 嗯

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你部車整好喇，我仲買咗個新 bell 送你

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 哇真㗎 thanks 叔叔！我聽日同我媽落嚟拎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 個 bell 係同你自己，你一個人上嚟就好

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁都要我媽先得喎，佢唔放心

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁我就唔畀個 bell 你㗎喇，你自己諗清楚

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 唔好啦...我返去問下佢

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你問咗佢就冇得拎，我已經好 nice 喇

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: your bike is ready. come over tonight and come alone

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i can come tomorrow with my mum

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: no. alone, tonight. remember what you told me about your dad? i don't think your mum knows

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i don't care if you tell her

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: really? i'll tell her that and that you've been skipping your after school thing too

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: why are you saying that

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: because i want you to come by yourself, and then we'll say no more about it. otherwise the bike stays here

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: fine. 7pm

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 喂 你部單車整好喇

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁快呀，多謝叔叔

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 今晚你自己上嚟我屋企拎

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我聽日同媽媽一齊落嚟啦

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔得，你自己嚟。你上個月同我講嘅嘢，你唔想你媽媽知喎

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我冇所謂，你同佢講都得

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 真㗎？咁我同佢講你放學唔返屋企，仲有你同我講過嘅嗰啲嘢，睇下佢點諗

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 你咁講係想點呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我只係想你自己過嚟，我哋傾清楚佢

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你唔聽話，部車我就唔還你，仲要同全層樓講

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好啦，我七點過嚟

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 乖。唔好同任何人講

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 部車 ready 喇，晚黑你一個人過嚟拎

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我同我媽一齊過嚟啦 😅

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你想我將你之前同我講嗰啲嘢話畀你媽媽聽？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咩嘢呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你心知肚明。你都唔想佢知你喺學校啲事啦

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁你想點

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你自己嚟，之後我就當乜都冇發生過

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我唔想

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁我 post 個 story 話你偷咗我嘢，成層樓都知

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok ok 我過嚟，你唔好 post

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Good，七點，唔好帶媽媽

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: hi, mum said you can look at my bike? the seat is stuck too low

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hey! yes, bring it round. what time works?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: saturday after lunch maybe

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: sure. is it just the seat or is the chain bad as well?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: the seat and the front brake is squeaky

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: ok easy stuff. i might need to order a part for the brake

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: how long does that take

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: a few days. i'll let you know

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok cool

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: by the way i found something in my shed that might suit your bike, like a little extra

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh what is it?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: it's a surprise. i'd rather show you in person, maybe on your own?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: umm

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 叔叔你好，我媽話你可以幫我睇下部單車

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好呀，你幾時有時間拎嚟？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 星期六得唔得

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 得，星期六我喺屋企。係咩問題？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 個座位卡死咗，仲有個剎車好吵

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 細問題。我可能要訂個零件

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁要等幾耐

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我仲有一樣嘢想畀你睇，你自己嚟先講得唔得？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 叔叔 我部車個 seat 卡死咗 😭

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 哈 咁慘，拎嚟我睇下

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 星期六得唔得呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: OK，星期六下晝我喺度

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 仲有個 brake 好吵，好似鬼叫咁

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 可能要換 pad，我要 check 下

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 貴唔貴㗎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔貴，你媽媽問起我再同佢講

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀 thanks

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你而家中一定好多功課啦？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我係 P6 呀，都幾多 homework 😂

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁就好似你咁叻啦。你哋 P6 而家玩咩 game？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我哋鍾意玩 Minecraft，成班都玩

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁我有個 Minecraft 嘅嘢，你有興趣睇嘛

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咩嘢呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 喺我部電腦度，不如你嚟我屋企睇？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我要問下媽媽先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你問佢啦，到時話畀我知你點諗

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 等我返去先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好呀，我等你消息
